decisions.summary: Existing Kanban and CRM adapter are a baseline to verify, not proof of compliance.
The target pilot includes Kanban, table, detail and manual opportunity creation.

actions: Started a fresh delivery run without discarding the existing implementation.
Registered the existing route, adapter and tests as baseline evidence.
Preserved the previous intake run as historical evidence.
Added the proposed Opportunity card hierarchy, states, permissions and responsive rules to the design baseline.
next_handoff: WAITING_DESIGN_APPROVAL: review discovery and architecture design before specialized analysis.
notes: This run intentionally starts from INTAKE and does not inherit completion claims from run 001.
Existing code must be classified requirement-by-requirement as PASS, PARTIAL, FAIL or NOT_TESTED.

The current card is a partial baseline: it has core commercial fields and movement actions, but the proposed design requires explicit product/origin, activity health, indicators, permission states and responsive evidence.
